items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Monk wants me to go to Montreal with him tonight... So we were on the train it was Monk, Nelly, Charlie Ross and myself.

ctx.x: And were you playing primarily exclusively with him or did you do any other side jobs?

I did one side job. And one morning, it was a Friday morning or a Saturday morning. Sonny Rollins knocks on my door, you know I didn’t know it was him, but I opened my door and there he was. He said, you know he was just passing this information. He said,
“You know Monk is downstairs and he wants you do go to Montreal with him today”
